tokens.name: color-surface-default
tokens.usage: Semantic. Page/app background. Every text color is checked against it in both themes. Light: neutral-0 #fefcfd; dark: neutral-1000 #120e10.

tokens.name: color-surface-subtle
tokens.usage: Semantic. Alternating bands, sidebars, docs nav. Text-safe for all text tokens. Light: neutral-50 #faf5f7; dark: neutral-950 #1a1617.

tokens.name: color-surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Semantic. Inset wells, table header rows, badge backgrounds. Light: neutral-100 #f4eef0; dark: neutral-1000 #120e10.

tokens.name: color-surface-raised
tokens.usage: Semantic. Cards, popovers, menus. Pairs with a shadow in light mode, with a lighter surface in dark mode. Light: neutral-0 #fefcfd; dark: neutral-900 #241f21.

tokens.name: color-surface-hover
tokens.usage: Semantic. Hover fill for rows, nav items, ghost buttons. Worst-case surface for text contrast checks. Light: neutral-100 #f4eef0; dark: neutral-850 #30292c.

tokens.name: color-surface-code
tokens.usage: Semantic. Code block and inline code background. Light: neutral-50 #faf5f7; dark: neutral-950 #1a1617.

tokens.name: color-surface-selected
tokens.usage: Semantic. Selected row / current nav item fill (accent tint). Light: wine-50 #feeff4; dark: wine-950 #280f1a.

tokens.name: color-text-primary
tokens.usage: Semantic. Body copy and headings. >=15:1 on every surface, both themes. Light: neutral-950 #1a1617; dark: neutral-50 #faf5f7.

tokens.name: color-text-secondary
tokens.usage: Semantic. Supporting copy, metadata, table secondary cells. >=7:1 on every surface. Light: neutral-700 #554d50; dark: neutral-300 #cdc5c8.

tokens.name: color-text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Semantic. Lowest-emphasis readable text: placeholders, timestamps, captions. Still >=4.5:1 on every surface; do not go lighter. Light: neutral-600 #6f6669; dark: neutral-400 #aba2a5.

tokens.name: color-text-disabled
tokens.usage: Semantic. Disabled control labels only. Exempt from WCAG 1.4.3 (inactive UI), so NOT contrast-safe: never use for readable content. Light: neutral-400 #aba2a5; dark: neutral-600 #6f6669.

tokens.name: color-text-on-accent
tokens.usage: Semantic. Text and icons on accent fills (primary button). Light: near-white; dark: near-black. Light: neutral-0 #fefcfd; dark: neutral-1000 #120e10.

tokens.name: color-border-subtle
tokens.usage: Semantic. Decorative dividers and card outlines. Not a control boundary: under 3:1 on purpose. Light: neutral-150 #ece6e8; dark: neutral-850 #30292c.

tokens.name: color-border-default
tokens.usage: Semantic. Stronger decorative rules (table grid, section breaks). Not a control boundary. Light: neutral-200 #e3dcde; dark: neutral-800 #3d3638.

tokens.name: color-border-control
tokens.usage: Semantic. Input, checkbox, secondary-button boundaries. >=3:1 vs every surface (WCAG 1.4.11). Light: neutral-500 #898084; dark: neutral-500 #898084.

tokens.name: color-accent-default
tokens.usage: Semantic. Primary action fill, active indicators, the one brand color. Light: wine-700 #692746; dark: wine-400 #d1789e.

tokens.name: color-accent-hover
tokens.usage: Semantic. Hover state of accent fills and accent text. Light: wine-800 #4f1a33; dark: wine-300 #e799b9.

tokens.name: color-accent-active
tokens.usage: Semantic. Pressed state of accent fills. Light: wine-900 #381224; dark: wine-200 #f4c0d4.

tokens.name: color-accent-tint
tokens.usage: Semantic. Low-emphasis accent background (selected chips, highlighted callout). Accent text stays >=4.5:1 on it. Light: wine-50 #feeff4; dark: wine-950 #280f1a.

tokens.name: color-accent-tint-border
tokens.usage: Semantic. Decorative border for accent-tint areas. Light: wine-200 #f4c0d4; dark: wine-800 #4f1a33.

tokens.name: color-accent-text
tokens.usage: Semantic. Links and accent-coloured text. Links must also be underlined (never colour alone, WCAG 1.4.1). Light: wine-700 #692746; dark: wine-400 #d1789e.

tokens.name: color-focus-ring
tokens.usage: Semantic. Keyboard focus outline, drawn 2px wide at a 2px offset so it sits on the surface (>=3:1 vs every surface). Light: wine-700 #692746; dark: wine-300 #e799b9.

tokens.name: color-status-info-text
tokens.usage: Semantic. Approved 2026-09-26. Status info text colour (titles, labels). >=4.5:1 on default/subtle/raised surfaces and on its own status surface. Always pair with an icon and a text label: never colour alone. Light: blue-700 #065da0; dark: blue-300 #8ac3fe.

tokens.name: color-status-info-surface
tokens.usage: Semantic. Approved 2026-09-26. Status info callout/banner background. Light: blue-50 #ebf5ff; dark: blue-950 #0d1e2f.

tokens.name: color-status-info-border
tokens.usage: Semantic. Approved 2026-09-26. Status info border, indicator edge and icon. >=3:1 vs surfaces (WCAG 1.4.11). Lightness is staggered across statuses (danger is the darkest indicator in both themes, success/warning the lightest) so they stay distinguishable with red-green colour blindness. Light: blue-600 #166eb9; dark: blue-400 #60aaf3.

tokens.usage: Dialogs and drawers entering. Nothing in the system is slower. Reduced motion: 0ms.

tokens.name: easing-enter

breakpoint.note: Min-width, in rem (= em in media queries) so they follow user zoom.

tokens.usage: >=640px: large phones landscape.

tokens.name: breakpoint-md

textTreatment.note: The dyslexia/dyscalculia treatment as tokens (brief: Typography). Applied to every text style above; these are the same values for CSS that type styles cannot carry (word spacing, measure, figures).

tokens.name: text-letter-spacing-400
tokens.usage: Tracking for weight 400 (sans). BDA: inter-letter gap ~35% of average letter width; measured Atkinson Hyperlegible Next default gap 0.084em = 21% of 0.393em, so +0.055em.

tokens.name: text-letter-spacing-600
tokens.usage: Tracking for weight 600 (sans): default gap 17% of letter width at this weight.

tokens.name: text-letter-spacing-700
tokens.usage: Tracking for weight 700 (sans): default gap 15% of letter width at this weight.

tokens.name: text-letter-spacing-mono-400
tokens.usage: Mono 400 default gap is already 39% of letter width: no extra tracking.

tokens.name: text-letter-spacing-mono-700
tokens.usage: Mono 700 tracking to reach 35%.

tokens.name: text-word-spacing
tokens.usage: Word spacing for sans 400 so the word gap is >=3.5x the letter gap (BDA). 600/700 already exceed it with their tracking: use 0 there.

tokens.name: text-line-height
tokens.usage: Minimum line height for every text style (BDA, WCAG 1.4.12). Nothing in the system goes lower.

tokens.name: paragraph-spacing
tokens.usage: Space after paragraphs (one line). Layouts must still survive a user override to 2em (WCAG 1.4.12).

tokens.name: measure-prose
tokens.usage: Body measure ~65 characters. In em, not ch: Atkinson Next is proportional and its 0 is wide, so 1ch = 1.3 average characters and 65ch would give ~84 characters.

tokens.name: measure-prose-min
tokens.usage: ~60 characters: lower bound of the 60-70 range.

tokens.name: measure-prose-max
tokens.usage: ~70 characters: never wider for running text.

tokens.name: font-variant-numeric
tokens.usage: Default figure style everywhere (Atkinson Next ships proportional digits by default; tnum is available). Mono is tabular by construction.

tokens.name: font-variant-ligatures
tokens.usage: No ligatures anywhere (the mono ships none; keeps glyphs distinct).

tokens.name: text-emphasis-weight
tokens.usage: Emphasis = bold. Never italic or underline for emphasis in body text.

tokens.name: text-emphasis-style
tokens.usage: Emphasis never changes font-style.

tokens.name: text-align
tokens.usage: Left-aligned, never justified.
